liebermann.notes: Copy of the Flores historiarum from St Albans, into which an interpolator at St Paul's, London, inserted (f. 33) ECf retr 10–10,3.

entries.text_de: London, Lambeth 1106 um 1325. Im Londoner Dom setzt in die Flores historiarum3 aus St. Alban’s, f. 33 ein Interpolator ECf retr 10—10, 3, u. S. 634, hinein.
entries.text_en: London, Lambeth 1106, c. 1325. In the London cathedral an interpolator inserts into the Flores historiarum3 from St Alban’s, f. 33, ECf retr 10—10, 3, below, p. 634.
